title: Hilbert's seventh problem, and powers of 2 and 3
relevant_concepts: Baker theorem special case for log 2 / log 3
polynomial lower bound on the normalized gap
notes: What's new, 21 August 2011. Expository special case of Baker: |log 2 / log 3 - p/q| >= c/q^C, hence |3^p - 2^q| >= (c/q^C) 3^p — exponential-in-the-exponents separation with only a polynomial normalized gap. This is the shape already tested and dominated by the exact Juggler finance gap (docs/problems/juggler_cycle_gap_baker.md). Recorded so the laboratory does not re-import a generic Baker constant as a leftover killer.
